strings.en: If this is my fate... then I will see it through.
I was born to fight./　Whatever my opponent may be...!
I have decided to lend my strength/　to Josh and the others.
For now, alongside humanity.../　I live this borrowed life.
I won't let you interfere.
If they are Josh's enemies, they are mine as well...
I shall handle this.
Fighting is the reason I was born. So I fight./　To live alongside Josh.
I am a Meliores Esse.../　But now, I am one who fights/　and lives alongside humans.
There...!
I will... shoot you down.
I will shoot you down.
You intend to stop me with that machine?
I shall open the way.
Can you afford to underestimate your opponent?
Once frozen, you will be silent.
He feels like a different person entirely.../　but it is that man.
If you would target Josh and the others,/　first try to shoot me down.
Strong. Then for the sake of Josh and the others,/　I must defeat you here...
Accept your fate of destruction, Al-Van.
You should return to your cold slumber once more.
I see hesitation in your heart, warrior of the Fury.
You remind me of Contagio...
One with a heart like yours cannot stop me.
For Josh and the others, you shall perish here.
I shall hold you back, so-called Knight Commander.
Atone for your past sins with your life.
I shall triumph over even the Baran-Schneil.
Gomoudokka, I shall freeze you still./　For Josh and the others.
So that Josh and the others can go on,/　you will vanish here.
Herluga, I shall defeat you./　That, too, will give my life meaning.
What is that thing...
It means to gather masses of malice...
If you are Josh's enemy,/　I shall destroy you, Debudedabide.
Can you destroy even me, Debudedabide?/　I, who was created to fight?
What... is this wave?
I sense no emotion. Then it is an enemy.
Whatever happens, an enemy is an enemy./　I fight all the same.
Bizarre creatures, begone.
The Crystal Dragon... Shatter before my freezing aura.
Skull Knight, whatever you may be,/　if you hinder Josh and the others, I will defeat you.
If it is a being like we once were,/　then its purpose is...
Another aberration, and without human will.
I could fight even the King of Destruction,/　who created me. Then I can surely/　fight a being such as that...
XN-L... you who bring ruin upon humanity./　Unless I erase you here, it will bode ill/　for Josh and the others.
Aliens...
Small fry, stay out of my way.
I have no time for small fry.
You mean to face me with such movements?
I will not let you hinder Josh and the others.
A battle carrier... I shall sink it.
A machine not in the data I checked...
If I know it is an enemy,/　its true identity does not matter to me.
The Fury, is it...
Unlucky of you to come before me, Fury.
Whatever its aim, if it is an enemy, I will shoot it down.
White Horn confirmed.
I shall shoot down that White Horn.
A Thorn... I sense power from this enemy.
I shall face the Thorn.
Merely fleeing is not in my nature.
Hostile aliens will receive no mercy.
Whatever world they hail from,/　if they are Josh's enemies, I will strike them down.
Negative thoughts... a mass of them...
Malice given form...
Even given form, malice cannot defeat me.
You who emit negative waves, scatter as ice.
Waves of negativity that weak,/　however many are gathered, are no threat to me.
Oh... It fused the masses of malice even further.
Whatever form it may take,/　I will never be defeated by negative waves.
The Lamaris will obstruct Josh and the others./　I must erase them.
It emits a powerful negative wave...
That negative wave is dangerous.
It binds together such enormous negative waves...
A massive aggregate of malice.../　I doubt this is the end of it.
I recognize this negative wave...
My role, it seems, is to hold you back./　You will face me.
I will not let the bringer of ruin be summoned.
You won't escape.
So you are still there.
No matter where you run...
Now it is my turn to strike.
Where do you think you're going?
So this is as far as I go...!
Forgive me, Josh...!
I-I cannot lose here.../　For Josh and the others' sake...!
Ngh!/　To overwhelm Fabularis like this...!
I-I cannot perish yet...!
Ugh...! The damage is severe...!
I cannot withdraw yet...!/　Yes, I am still...!
To make me falter...!
Impossible... Fabularis, like this...!
Even if this body is shattered...!
Ngh, a direct hit.../　on this Fabularis!
For the sake of Josh, who gave me life,/　I cannot lose!
No matter how damaged the Fabularis becomes...!
As long as I live,/　the Fabularis will not stop!
I will not lose./　To live alongside Josh...!
Am I being swallowed/　by that one's negative waves...?
For Josh's sake, Al-Van, I will...!
Female knight of the Fury.../　I cannot end in a place like this!
If I do not strike down Karo-Ran, Josh and the others...
Ngh... However much power you have,/　you cannot become a king...!
Ugh, Vort... I can still fight.
I am a Meliores Esse... born to fight./　I will not fall to a mere alien woman.
The Cross Gate's power is immense.../　I cannot leave it be.
I cannot let Debudedabide defeat me like this...!
This is not over yet, Crystal Dragon!
Grotesque knight, I have not fallen yet!
I will not lose to the likes of you!/　I will return alive with Josh! No matter what!
I-I can't let that power swallow me...!
A direct hit from Thorn...? But I am not done yet.
To let such a mass of malice land a direct hit...
What are these negative waves...!
Such negative waves...!
...I won't let you go any further.
Ngh, this is...!
I've been hurt...!
To take a hit head-on...!
Ngh, a direct hit...!
My fight isn't over yet...!
Fabularis is responding sluggishly...!
This isn't enough to bring me down...!
Am I... being pushed back?
If I am beaten like this,/　I will have failed Josh.
Fabularis will not fall to this much.
Ugh... I cannot let you do any more.
Not yet. If you think that is enough to stop me...
Overconfidence in your own power is your weakness.
So you managed that... Jua-Mu.
Your malice is growing, Jua-Mu.
Al-Van is not to be underestimated./　For Josh's sake, I must defeat him...
Fabularis is being overpowered?/　The Fury's woman knight... she is formidable.
I never thought this Karo-Ran was so strong...
Strong. So this is the Emperor Unit's power./　Underestimate it, and even Fabularis won't last...
This war merchant is quite capable as well./　If you stand in Josh's way, I must eliminate you...
Vort Nikolaus... I see, a seasoned warrior.
Well done, alien woman...!
I cannot let him have the Cross Gate...!
Beaten by such a clown... Was I careless?
You have done it now, Crystal Dragon...!
Skull Knight.../　Was it, too, created only to fight...?
XN-L... I will not be erased by the likes of you!
That I would fall behind... Outworlders are capable.
I will not let you do as you please any longer,/　outworlder.
Not yet. I will not let you hinder Josh and the others.
Thorn... keeping up with my movements...
So this is the power of the Raftclans...
At this rate, I may take a direct hit./　Curse this outworlder...
Baran-Schneil... I will not flinch at this.
How pathetic... I, who was born to fight,/　bested by a mere mass of malice...!
Did I underestimate it as a mere mass/　of negative waves...?
A collective of malice.../　with power beyond my predictions?
Ugh, the Ida Type... This malice is immense.
Was I dragged in by those negative waves...!
Ares Geist's negative waves are growing stronger...
Such an attack won't work on me.
That's not enough to shatter me.
What are you playing at?
...No problem.
Don't underestimate Fabularis.
And what of it?
The damage is negligible.
All you did was land a hit...
The damage is minor. No problem at all.
That will not work on me.
A hit, yes, but only this much.
Too weak to face my Fabularis.
It has no effect, So-Des.
Oh? You can hit me, Jua-Mu?
How noisy...
You think that will destroy me, Jua-Mu?
I see... Al-Van is not to be taken lightly.
Surely that is not the end of it,/　Karo-Ran?
Hm... so this is the Emperor Unit./　It seems I must avoid a direct hit.
Your strength doesn't match your looks.
Gomoudokka, is that the extent of your power?
You merely hit me, alien woman.
Minor damage? With the Cross Gate's power,/　I would expect more than this...
You are weaker than you look, Debudedabide.
Shallow, Crystal Dragon.
Is that all, Skull Knight?
You merely hit me, XN-L.
If that is the best attack you can manage,/　you are no match for me, outworlder.
Hmph, is this all the power outworlders have?
Good. Now keep me company a while longer.
Thorn... so you can hit me.
You hit me?/　Is it the Raftclans' power, or its pilot's...
I failed to dodge./　Outworlders are better than I thought.
No problem at all. Is that all, outworlder?
To be hit by a jumble of negative waves...
Even a collective of malice,/　at this level, I can withstand.
An immense mass of malice... I cannot take many hits.
You won't hit me.
You can't reach me.
Where are you looking?
You cannot catch the Fabularis.
You are no match for the Fabularis.
Did you think you could hit me?
I am one born to fight./　An attack like that is...
That will not leave a single scratch on my Fabularis.
If I were hit by such a thing,/　I would be of no use to Josh.
Futile. It will not hit Fabularis.
You underestimate me.
The more emotional one is, the easier to control.
One consumed by negative waves is no threat at all.
You cannot stop me, Al-Van.
This will never destroy me,/　Karo-Ran.
Is this your power, Knight Commander?
However you use the Cross Gate's power,/　it means nothing if you cannot hit.
I may not read emotions, but I can dodge this much.
I can read that with ease, Crystal Dragon.
Grotesque knight, your skills will not work.
XN-L, can you not even catch me?
Do not think the likes of you can stop me,/　outworlder.
Is that all, Thorn?
Cease this futility, outworlder.
Malice will not work on me.
However you wield negative waves, you will not hit me.
Stronger negative waves change nothing.
However immense, it is mere malice in the end.
Is Duban Org's will lingering?/　Even so, it will not hit me.
It's nothing.
It seems I evaded it.
Jua-Mu,/　that will never hit me.
Can you afford to hold back against me,/　woman knight of the Fury?
Alien woman,/　you think that will destroy me?
Withdraw, outworlder./　You are no match for me.
Your sword cannot pierce me.
I will not be struck by your negative waves.
I no longer need negative waves.
Something like that...
That trick won't work.
That has no effect on me.
Useless.
Unable to attack.
To be able to do nothing...
I can't counter, then.
If there is anything I can do...
I'll handle the rest.
This, too, is my duty.
I'll give you no chance to escape.
Josh, I've got your back.
Josh, I will lend you my strength.
I will follow up as well, Josh.
I knew it would come to this./　Josh, leave the rest to me.
Let me help, Rim.
Rim, take my power...
Rim, leave the rest to me.
Let us fight together, Rim. I will follow.
A strange one. But lending a hand is not unpleasant.
That woman. If Josh sees her as an ally,/　I can hardly refuse to help.
I'll be your opponent!
I'll take this one.
I'll take the blow.
Leave it to me.
Josh, I will protect you.
I won't let you harm Josh!
I told you I would back you up,/　Josh.
You target Josh? I will not allow it.
Fall back, Rim.
Rim, leave the rest to me.
Rim, I will cover you. Fall back.
Protecting you is my role as well, Rim.
Josh told me to protect you. I will cover you.
If you fall, it will trouble Josh.
Stand back, Calvina Coulange.
This ends now...!
Accept your fate...!
You who surround me, taste my icy blades!
Pierce my foes, blades of ice!
Blades of ice...
Virite Gladius...
Whatever my ice blade touches...
Your time shall freeze still!
Turn to ice and shatter!
...shall all freeze and shatter!
Feel my freezing chill.
Unleash the cold, Fabularis.
None can escape my frost.
An icy prison shall engulf you...!
Parvus Acies!
Go!
Congelatio!
You can resist no longer!
Now, sink into the cold darkness...!
Take this blow!
Everything you are shall freeze!
I shall lead you into an inescapable icy hell.
Little blades of ice!
Strike down our foes!
Now, shatter in ice! In the cold darkness!
